name: Amanojaku Nightmare
storyline:
Once upon a time, Onijin Seija plotted to overthrow Gensokyo. After a life of flight and misdeeds, Seija was finally captured and forced to relive a recurring nightmare in which she is tormented by the strongest warriors.

The Dream Keeper declares, “This is your punishment. If you cease your rebellion, you may awaken from this dream.”

“No way! Defiance is the very essence of an Amanojaku’s way of life!”

Will Seija be able to break free from this senseless nightmare…!
summary: Based on the Touhou Project, this is a fantastical and intense bullet-hell Shoot 'em up. Dive into a nightmare where Gensokyo’s strongest fighters gather, and aim to conquer it. There are no special systems or complex controls. From Beginners players to those who have “graduated from being human,” we await your challenge.
